diagram_math_checks.evidence: Read exact definitions A^r_{p,n}=F_p C_n intersect d^{-1}(F_{p-r}C_{n-1}), B^r=A^{r-1}_{p-1,n}+d A^{r-1}_{p+r-1,n+1}, E^r=Z^r/B^r and separate r=0 quotient. Steps 1.1, 2.1, 2.2 and 3.1 place products in the target numerator and each denominator factor into the target denominator. Under p=-a and n=-(a+b), multiplicative filtration gives target (a+c,b+e); the illustration does not add new quotient conventions.

H_r^{a,b} is explicitly H(E_r,d_r)^{a,b}. Top map has domain H_r^{a,b} tensor_R H_r^{c,e} and codomain H_r^{a+c,b+e}; bottom has the same bidegrees on E_{r+1}. The left vertical arrow is alpha_r tensor alpha_r and the right is alpha_r on summed bidegree. These are R-linear maps and require no tensor-homology isomorphism or flatness.

Exact differential supplier gives homological (-r,r-1), and cohomological construction negates indices to (r,1-r). Step 4.1 translates (-1)^n to (-1)^{a+b}, not (-1)^a. Thus products of d_r-cycles are cycles and multiplying a d_r-boundary by a cycle gives a boundary in either variable; this induces the top product.

Next-page theorem defines alpha_r:H(E^r,d^r) to E^{r+1}, inverse to the inclusion-induced comparison. Its Steps 1.2 and 3.1 require correction by lower filtration and prove correction independence. This item Step 5.1 proves alpha_r(uv)=alpha_r(u)alpha_r(v), exactly the only square relation. No arrow from arbitrary E_r elements to E_{r+1} is asserted.

The square holds for each r>=0 using Steps 4.1 and 5.1. Only Step 4.2 and the cohomological construction under degreewise finite filtration identify E_infinity with gr_F H(K), using image filtration im(H(F^a K) to H(K)); final prose retains that condition. All original numbered proof steps remain byte-identical and prove the claims without the picture.
